4-stages-whole-house-water-filter-and-uv.shortDescription: 4-stage whole-house water filter system with three Big Blue filtration stages plus a 48 W UV lamp, rated up to 34 L/min at a 40 mJ/cm² UV dose, 45 L/min at 30 mJ/cm² and 85 L/min at 16 mJ/cm².
4-stages-whole-house-water-filter-and-uv.description:
A complete **4-stage whole-house filtration and UV disinfection system** combining three Big Blue cartridge stages with a stainless-steel UV chamber so incoming water is filtered before it reaches the UV lamp.

The filtration configuration is **sediment → GAC carbon → polishing carbon block → UV-C**. The first three stages reduce suspended sediment plus chlorine, taste and odour before the UV stage treats the clarified water.

## UV performance

The UV system does not have one single flow rating independent of UV dose. Its maximum rated flow depends on the UV dose required:

- **34 L/min at 40 mJ/cm²**
- **45 L/min at 30 mJ/cm²**
- **85 L/min at 16 mJ/cm²**

For applications where a higher UV dose is the priority, use the **34 L/min at 40 mJ/cm²** figure as the key design point rather than the 85 L/min maximum-flow figure. The manual notes that the published flow ratings are shown at **95% UV transmittance (UVT)**.

## UV system specifications

- **UV lamp power:** 48 W
- **Maximum power consumption:** 63 W
- **Supply:** 100–240 V AC, 50/60 Hz
- **UV chamber:** SUS304 stainless steel
- **UV inlet / outlet:** 3/4" and 1" BSPT
- **Rated lamp service life:** 9,000 hours
- **Operating pressure:** 4–100 PSI
- **Ambient air temperature:** 2–50 °C
- **Maximum humidity:** 95%
- **Maximum water hardness:** 120 ppm
- **Maximum iron:** 0.3 ppm
- **Minimum UVT:** 75%
- **Frame:** coated steel standing bracket

## Why upstream filtration matters

UV performance depends heavily on water clarity. Sediment, colour and dissolved material can reduce UV transmission and shield microorganisms from the lamp. The three cartridge stages therefore do more than improve taste and appearance: they help prepare the water for more effective UV treatment.

## What this system targets

This system combines **sediment filtration, activated carbon and UV disinfection**. The filtration stages reduce dirt, sand, silt and rust plus chlorine, taste and odour; the UV stage is used for microbiological treatment when the water quality and flow are within the stated operating limits.

This system is **not a water softener**. Dissolved calcium and magnesium that cause hardness and scale require ion-exchange softening or membrane treatment.

## Installation and maintenance

Install the system on the incoming water line with suitable isolation and bypass arrangements so cartridges and the UV lamp can be serviced. For mains-connected installations, use an appropriately licensed plumber. Replace the UV lamp according to its rated service life of approximately **9,000 operating hours**, even if the lamp still illuminates, because germicidal UV output declines with use.

uv-water-filter-ultraviolet-sterilisatio.description:
A **25W ultraviolet water steriliser** for whole-home and commercial water-treatment applications using the confirmed **Philips TUV 25W/G25 T8** germicidal UV-C lamp.

- **Lamp model:** Philips TUV 25W/G25 T8

- **Lamp type:** T8 germicidal UV-C lamp
- **Lamp power:** 25W
- **UV-C output:** 7.3W at 100 hours
- **Peak UV-C wavelength:** approximately 253.7 nm (254 nm)
- **Nominal lamp voltage:** 48V
- **Nominal lamp current:** 0.612A
- **Rated useful life:** 9,000 hours
- **UV-C output depreciation at useful-life point:** approximately 15%

- **Tube diameter:** approximately 28 mm
- **Maximum overall length:** approximately 451.6 mm
